value.answer: Tomorrow in Windsor looks hot and mostly sunny, with a high around 29 to 31°C and a humidex near 35. It may start with a shower or thunderstorm chance early on, then clear up by late morning. Winds pick up from mid-afternoon into the evening, around 30 km/h with gusts to 50. The evening should be clear, but showers are likely overnight.
